purpose: Publish reproducible root-level full-cycle CPU diagnostic figures and matching CSVs from sealed review artifacts. No solver, decoder, new theory calculation, fit or interpolation.
figures: profiles: all ten requested Tv targets including 1.5 and 2, finite-Kw solid curves and same-color current open circles; separate late-profile view
history: complete pressure/top/bottom material histories, same-time H1 finite/classical companions, qualified old u-pw, and late pressure/top/bottom error views
startup: the saved pressure/top/bottom response through 0.1 s with no discarded oscillations
overview: pressure profiles, mean pressure history and top material settlement
diagnostics: vertical-layer Q, total-stress residual and old 100 Pa line, bottom bias, distinct alternating-X modes, J/n/actual native rho, final all-layer stress profile
qualified_upw_profiles: byte-exact copy of the previously reviewed old/new ten-target profile figure, preserving its own-time reference qualifications
CSV_outputs: Byte-exact copies of all five full-review CSVs including all 168200 layer rows, three overlay CSVs and two focus CSVs; new endpoint reference/error summary and ten-target layer-mean profile RMS summary.
numerical_labels: Actual recorded times/Tv and signed target gaps retained; no matched-time or isolated A/B claim.
Layer-mean RMS uses 100 material layers; endpoint native-node RMS is a separately labeled 1000-ID statistic.
H1 is primary; H=.995 remains an unfitted sensitivity in copied CSVs and endpoint summary, never a selected fitted truth.
Same-native-node arithmetic/J-weighted means remain distinct from continuum integral means.
Current CPU1/FreeSlip3/dt6.250143us/currentJ-inertia differs from old GPU/Vel0/dt10us/legacy inertia and drainage event.

Finite-Kw/classical ideal-drainage companions do not reproduce the dynamic ramp, normalized current-top 2h load band, inertia or deformed quadrature exactly. The sealed root note's load_band_layers=5 is not used: the actual cutoff is within 2h of current zmax, initially four material layers at h=.018 and dp=.01.
All plotted axes are linear. Startup/late/post-0.1 windows are explicitly named; matching complete histories remain available.
The retained old 100 Pa stress criterion is shown, including current exceedances, without adding or relaxing a new-run accuracy gate. Plotting pass is not unconditional physical/formal acceptance.
guards: Require pinned passed diagnostic receipts, exact full row counts and 100 ordered layers per target, exact current history/theory time membership, and the correct overlay full-review association. Hash every consumed receipt/file/script/note before and after. Refuse any existing destination; exclusive creation protects retained data. Copy source CSV/qualified PNG bytes exactly. Future plotting uses Windows BelowNormal priority, one BLAS/OpenMP thread and PNG160dpi.
author_validation: Manual source/schema review and AST/JSON-only static checks; plotting code is not imported or executed by author. Parent owns visual review of the actual generated PNGs before publication claims.
